# App Research Agent: 100 apps, agent-toolkit readiness (Dhruv Paleja, Composio take-home)

> One record per app: auth, self-serve vs gated access, API surface, MCP status, a buildability verdict,
> and the evidence (URL + verbatim quote + grounding score) behind each claim.

## Files
- results.json: array of 100 records (fields below)
- results.csv: same data, one row per app
- index.html: human-readable case study (patterns, findings, agent design, verification)

## Fields
- auth_methods: subset of OAUTH2 | API_KEY (any static key/token/PAT) | BASIC | OTHER (signed/HMAC/JWT) | NONE
- auth_primary: the method a multi-user agent toolkit should use
- access: self_serve_free | self_serve_trial | paid_plan | app_review | partner_gated | no_public_api
- api_type: REST | GraphQL | REST+GraphQL | SDK_or_CLI_only | other_protocol | none ; api_breadth: broad|moderate|narrow|none
- mcp: official (vendor-run) | community (third-party only) | none ; mcp_url
- verdict: ready | ready_with_friction | needs_outreach | not_buildable ; blocker + blocker_notes
- in_composio / composio_slugs / composio_auth: matching toolkits in Composio's catalog at research time
- evidence[]: {field, url, quote, grounding}; grounding = share of the quote's word 3-grams found on the page when re-fetched
- changed_by_verification: fields whose value changed between pass 1 and final, as [before, after]
- human_override: present when a person decided a field from the human review queue

## Trust
Accuracy was measured on a 30-app stratified random sample checked by hand (see index.html#verify).
Records with open_flags were not fully settled by the agent; prefer the evidence quote over the label there.
